show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Alex Sacerdote – Riding S-Curves at Whale Rock (EP.436)
summary:
Our conversation covers Alex’s path to running
Whale Rock, shaped by early exposure to the markets through his
father, a longtime partner at Goldman Sachs, and his formative
years at Fidelity. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors.

reader_summary.headline: Alex Sacerdote is the founder of Whale Rock Capital Management.
reader_summary.overview: Alex Sacerdote is the founder of Whale Rock Capital Management, a technology-focused investment firm that manages $8 billion across hedge fund, long only, and hybrid strategies. Our conversation covers Alex's path to running Whale Rock, shaped by early exposure to the markets through his father, a longtime partner at Goldman Sachs.

key_points.text: Our conversation covers Alex's path to running Whale Rock, shaped by early exposure to the markets through his father.
We dive into the key lessons he learned at Fidelity, the development of his investment framework centered around S-curves, competitive advantages.
